description:
Quality audit 2026-05-16 using screaming-architecture-audit found Agent Inbox no longer has a durable architecture map that matches its code shape. The scenario README names the product mental model as inbox + dispatcher + chat timeline, but there is no docs/concepts/ARCHITECTURE.md or docs/internal/ARCHITECTURE.md. Existing docs/SEAMS.md focuses on async tool tracking and still describes domain as api/domain plus api/services types, while the current code has broader domains spread through generic buckets: API handlers include chat, message branching, labels, settings, templates, tools, skills, usage, uploads, async status, AI streaming, and agent mode; services include completion, async tracker, prompt sync, templates, storage, skill suggestion, tool registry, tool persistence, model registry, and reconciliation; UI has many product concepts under generic components/chat, components/settings, hooks, and lib API files. This makes future changes harder to place and encourages more behavior to land in services/hooks by locality rather than by product ownership.

Draft plan: (1) add a stable architecture document for agent-inbox that names the real product domains such as inbox/chat timeline, dispatch/tool execution, agent mode/run attachment, labels/organization, templates/skills, settings/model/tool configuration, attachments/storage, async operations, search/usage, and scenario integration; (2) map each domain to current API/UI/CLI/test source paths without moving code in the first pass; (3) update docs/SEAMS.md so its responsibility zones reflect current domains and note where generic packages are intentional infrastructure versus domain-owned implementation; (4) add docs/PROBLEMS.md entries for concrete follow-up moves, for example splitting api/services by domain and introducing UI feature/domain folders only where the map shows repeated ownership confusion; (5) after docs are aligned, perform one small structural relocation or package split with tests if a high-confidence domain boundary is obvious.

Acceptance: the scenario has a durable architecture doc with domain map, shared infrastructure map, maturity-by-surface notes, and links to seams/problems; docs/SEAMS.md no longer describes the whole domain layer as api/domain plus api/services types only; future agents can answer where to add a chat, tool-dispatch, template, settings, or agent-mode change from docs alone; no broad behavior rewrite is required in this item. Suggested skills: screaming-architecture-audit, boundary-of-responsibility-enforcement, cognitive-load-reduction.
name: agent-inbox-screaming-architecture-domain-map
title: Clarify Agent Inbox domain-owned architecture map
